name: WhisperTranscribe
summary: AI transcription and translation for podcasts, videos and interviews with speaker detection, content generation and many export formats, plus a bot-free meeting assistant; plans by minutes a month with unlimited users.
best_for: podcasters, YouTubers, researchers and small teams who transcribe a predictable number of hours a month, want unlimited users without seat fees, and prefer a service that does not keep their files
skip_if: you transcribe only occasionally (pay-as-you-go or a free tier elsewhere may be cheaper), you need the vendor to store a searchable archive for you, or your recordings may not leave the EU for AI processing
honest_knock: Starter's card advertises $2.80 an hour, but 320 minutes for $19.99 a month is about $3.75 an hour, our arithmetic. Monthly billing costs twice the annual rate on every plan, and fees and unused credits are non-refundable under the terms. Transcripts are not kept on the vendor's servers after delivery, which is good for privacy but means a lost local copy is gone. Some AI processing runs in the United States. The pricing page says translation into 99 languages while its comparison table says 65+. The terms of 20 October 2026 add a 14-day withdrawal right for EU, EEA and UK consumers on subscriptions, refunded minus the service already used; buying a credit package gives up that right once the credits are in your account. Subscription minutes expire every cycle, and the terms cap liability at the fees paid in the previous 12 months, or €0 for a user who paid nothing.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month billed annually ($240 a year) for 320 transcription minutes a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-14 in a live browser on whispertranscribe.com/pricing and the terms of use then dated 28 October 2025; the terms and privacy policy were re-read on 25 October 2026 in their versions of 20 and 19 October 2026) Two products. Transcription plans, priced by minutes of uploaded audio a month, with unlimited users: Starter $19.99 a month billed annually ($240 a year) or $39.99 monthly for 320 minutes; Pro $29.99 annually ($360) or $59.99 monthly for 800 minutes; Grow $69.99 ($840) or $139.99 for 2,500 minutes; Scale $139.99 ($1,680) or $279.99 for 6,000 minutes. The annual toggle is labelled save 50%. Each plan includes one free Meeting Assistant seat, files up to 10 hours long (5 GB on Starter, 10 GB above), AI clips, podcast search, import from web links, exports to Word, PDF, TXT, SRT, VTT, CSV, XLSX, JSON and ELAN, and priority support on Grow and Scale. Pay-as-you-go minutes start at $8 an hour, bought in the app, and never expire. The Meeting Assistant, which captures calls without a bot joining, is $16 a seat a month billed annually ($192) or $20 monthly, with a 7-day trial. The terms of 20 October 2026 say every new user gets 60 free credits on signup, that a cancelled account stays active on the free tier, and that fees and unused credits are non-refundable apart from the EU/UK withdrawal right, billing errors, duplicate charges and service failure. Re-read on 25 October 2026 with a plain fetch: all transcription and Meeting Assistant prices unchanged. The Meeting Assistant toggle says save 20%, not the 50% of the transcription plans: $192 a year against $240 for twelve monthly payments. The plan table lists support as Standard (24h) on Starter and Pro and Priority on Grow and Scale, and extra team users on the transcription plans as free.

compare_with.name: Descript
compare_with.why: Descript is in our dossiers too, read on 1 October 2026: free for 60 minutes a month, Hobbyist $16 per person a month billed annually ($24 monthly) for 10 media hours, and it is a full audio and video editor with seats. WhisperTranscribe, read on 14 October 2026, is $19.99 a month billed annually for 320 minutes of transcription with unlimited users and no editor. If you edit media, Descript; if you only need transcripts and content from them for a team, WhisperTranscribe charges for minutes instead of seats.
